summary:
Attempt 42 fixes O-028 as the disposition asked, and I found nothing new worth filing.

What changed (diff 9387de0..32ce91a):
- DrivePanel is now a horizontal StackPanel inside DriveScroller (MainWindow.xaml:13-22). Its horizontal scroll bar is always shown and its vertical one disabled, so PickerPanel's height no longer depends on the drive count.
- The window's Height and MinHeight go from 600 to 620 (MainWindow.xaml:5), because the scroll-bar lane left 0.3 px of spare room at 600.
- LoadDrives' button bottom margin is now 0.
- WindowReport adds the additive keys PickerPanel {actualHeight} and DrivePanel {buttons}.
- The hook gains FSA_HOOK_DRIVES=n, for watch, expand and size only, refused otherwise. It adds n buttons copied from the first real one after the real ones are in, and holds the report until then.
- B-007 adds 26 drive buttons in seven of its eight runs and asserts, through CheckPickers, that PickerPanel is the same height in all of them while the button counts differ. B-008 adds 26 as well.
- The XAML comments and docs/design/SL-039-live-results.md now state the guarantee with its conditions: 560x620 and up, 100% scaling, any number of drives.

I grepped src, docs, tests/window and eng. Nothing still refers to 880x600, 560x600, a WrapPanel or a second line of drive buttons, except the comment's own "at 600 px they would have 0.3 px to spare".

What I ran:
- WindowCases -Case All: all 26 non-network cases pass. B-007's pickers line shows 152.78 px in all 8 runs, with 3 real drive buttons in one and 29 in the other seven.
- HookCases H-001 and H-002: pass.
- Core tests: 181 of 181 pass.
- rules-parity: AGREE.
- Fitness: all 29 rules hold.

The earlier shape I measured by hand, with the pickers wrapping to a second line, is now fed in by the project's own cases with 26 extra buttons at both sizes. That makes the minimum-size runs independent of what is plugged into the machine.

drift: Declared: the window's default size is now 880x620 and it cannot be made shorter than 620 DIPs. Every layout guarantee is measured at 100% scaling only.

Declared: the drive row always shows a horizontal scroll bar, disabled while every button fits, which on this PC is always. From reading the markup, not measured: with the vertical bar disabled, WPF's ScrollViewer does not turn the mouse wheel into sideways scrolling, so buttons past the edge are reached by the scroll bar or by Tab.

Still standing from earlier reviews: a largest file's location shows at most 3 lines, with the full path only in a tooltip. UnreadableList keeps MaxHeight=200 inside its 2* row. The plants.json F17 note still cites Scanner.cs:267, whereas the raw read is now at :281.
